Name: Sell Your Hay
Author: Suntooth
Description:
I always found it pretty weird that hay sells for 0g, so now it sells for 10g.

Note: Already-existing items will not be updated. This is not a limitation I can easily fix. The price of existing hay (as in, hay in chests etc, not in silos) may be able to be updated by putting it in silos then taking it back out again.

Manifest.Name: Sell Your Hay
Manifest.Description: Makes hay sell for 10g, instead of for 0g.
Manifest.Author: Suntooth
